name: weave-demo
title: Weave workflow editor
description: An n8n-style workflow editor built on Weave: node palette, run simulation, details dialog, mobile selection bar.

files.content:
import {
  Braces,
  Clock,
  Database,
  GitBranch,
  Globe,
  Mail,
  Merge,
  MessageSquare,
  MousePointerClick,
  Shuffle,
  Sparkles,
  Timer,
  Webhook,
  type LucideIcon,
} from "lucide-react";

export type Kind = "trigger" | "action" | "logic";

export interface CatalogItem {
  key: string;
  kind: Kind;
  label: string;
  description: string;
  icon: LucideIcon;
  tint: string;
  inputs: string[];
  outputs: string[];
  /** Takes tools: a port on the bottom edge. */
  tools?: boolean;
}

const one = { inputs: ["in"], outputs: ["out"] };

export const CATALOG: CatalogItem[] = [
  {
    key: "manual",
    kind: "trigger",
    label: "Manual trigger",
    description: "Runs when you click Execute",
    icon: MousePointerClick,
    tint: "bg-slate-500/12 text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-400",
    inputs: [],
    outputs: ["out"],
  },
  {
    key: "webhook",
    kind: "trigger",
    label: "Webhook",
    description: "Starts on an HTTP call",
    icon: Webhook,
    tint: "bg-violet-500/12 text-violet-600 dark:text-violet-400",
    inputs: [],
    outputs: ["out"],
  },
  {
    key: "schedule",
    kind: "trigger",
    label: "Schedule",
    description: "Runs on a cron interval",
    icon: Clock,
    tint: "bg-amber-500/12 text-amber-600 dark:text-amber-400",
    inputs: [],
    outputs: ["out"],
  },
  {
    key: "http",
    kind: "action",
    label: "HTTP request",
    description: "Call any REST endpoint",
    icon: Globe,
    tint: "bg-sky-500/12 text-sky-600 dark:text-sky-400",
    ...one,
  },
  {
    key: "ai",
    kind: "action",
    label: "AI agent",
    description: "Reason over the input",
    icon: Sparkles,
    tint: "bg-fuchsia-500/12 text-fuchsia-600 dark:text-fuchsia-400",
    ...one,
    tools: true,
  },
  {
    key: "code",
    kind: "action",
    label: "Code",
    description: "Run custom JavaScript",
    icon: Braces,
    tint: "bg-orange-500/12 text-orange-600 dark:text-orange-400",
    ...one,
  },
  {
    key: "db",
    kind: "action",
    label: "Database query",
    description: "Read or write rows",
    icon: Database,
    tint: "bg-blue-500/12 text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400",
    ...one,
  },
  {
    key: "email",
    kind: "action",
    label: "Send email",
    description: "Deliver a message",
    icon: Mail,
    tint: "bg-rose-500/12 text-rose-600 dark:text-rose-400",
    ...one,
  },
  {
    key: "chat",
    kind: "action",
    label: "Chat message",
    description: "Post to a team channel",
    icon: MessageSquare,
    tint: "bg-emerald-500/12 text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400",
    ...one,
  },
  {
    key: "transform",
    kind: "action",
    label: "Transform",
    description: "Map and reshape fields",
    icon: Shuffle,
    tint: "bg-teal-500/12 text-teal-600 dark:text-teal-400",
    ...one,
  },
  {
    key: "wait",
    kind: "action",
    label: "Wait",
    description: "Pause before continuing",
    icon: Timer,
    tint: "bg-lime-500/12 text-lime-600 dark:text-lime-400",
    ...one,
  },
  {
    key: "if",
    kind: "logic",
    label: "If",
    description: "Route by a condition",
    icon: GitBranch,
    tint: "bg-indigo-500/12 text-indigo-600 dark:text-indigo-400",
    inputs: ["in"],
    outputs: ["true", "false"],
  },
  {
    key: "merge",
    kind: "logic",
    label: "Merge",
    description: "Join two branches",
    icon: Merge,
    tint: "bg-indigo-500/12 text-indigo-600 dark:text-indigo-400",
    inputs: ["a", "b"],
    outputs: ["out"],
  },
];

export const byKey: Record<string, CatalogItem> = Object.fromEntries(CATALOG.map((i) => [i.key, i]));
